translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on dingyou, a Venus-bright star appeared south of Wall, streamed rapidly to west of Woman and vanished, red-yellow with a ground-lighting tail.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛未，星出胃南，如太白，慢行至婁西南沒，赤黃，有尾跡，明燭地。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinwei: a star emerged south of Stomach, like Venus, moved slowly to southwest of Bond and vanished, red-yellow, with a tail trail, its brightness lighting the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinwei, a Venus-bright star appeared south of Stomach, drifted slowly to southwest of Bond and vanished, red-yellow with a ground-lighting tail.

sentences.zh: 二年正月辛酉，星出太陽守東南，如太白，慢流至濁沒，青白，有尾跡，明燭地。

translations.literal: Year 2, first month, day xinyou: a star emerged southeast of Guardian of the Sun, like Venus, flowed slowly to the Murky and vanished, green-white, with a tail trail, its brightness lighting the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, first month, on xinyou, a Venus-bright star appeared southeast of Guardian of the Sun, drifted slowly into the Murky and vanished, green-white with a ground-lighting tail.

sentences.zh: 二月丙申，星出鉤陳東，如太白，西北慢流，至濁沒，青白。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingshen: a star emerged east of Hooked Array, like Venus, flowed slowly northwest, vanished in the Murky, green-white.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on bingshen, a Venus-bright star appeared east of Hooked Array, drifted slowly northwest into the Murky and vanished, green-white.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，星出天市垣趙星西南，如太白，急流至吳越星沒，赤黃，有尾跡，明燭地。

translations.literal: Day renyin: a star emerged southwest of Zhao Star within Celestial Market Enclosure, like Venus, flowed rapidly to Wu-Yue Star and vanished, red-yellow, with a tail trail, its brightness lighting the ground.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, a Venus-bright star appeared southwest of Zhao Star in the Celestial Market Enclosure, streamed rapidly to Wu-Yue Star and vanished, red-yellow with a tail bright enough to light the ground.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，星出靈臺北，如太白，向西慢行，至軒轅沒，赤黃，有尾跡，明燭地。

translations.literal: Day guimao: a star emerged north of Spirit Platform, like Venus, moved slowly westward, vanished at Chariot Shaft, red-yellow, with a tail trail, its brightness lighting the ground.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, a Venus-bright star appeared north of Spirit Platform, drifted slowly west to Chariot Shaft and vanished, red-yellow with a ground-lighting tail.

sentences.zh: 五月戊辰，星出氐西南，如太白，西南速行，至濁沒，青白，有尾跡，明燭地。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuchen: a star emerged southwest of Root, like Venus, moved swiftly southwest, vanished in the Murky, green-white, with a tail trail, its brightness lighting the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuchen, a Venus-bright star appeared southwest of Root, sped southwest into the Murky and vanished, green-white with a tail bright enough to light the ground.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉，星出亢池東，如太白，西北急流，至太微垣東扇上將沒，赤黃，有尾跡，明燭地。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingyou: a star emerged east of Neck Pool, like Venus, flowed rapidly northwest, vanished at Eastern Fan Senior General of Supreme Palace Enclosure, red-yellow, with a tail trail, its brightness lighting the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingyou, a Venus-bright star appeared east of Neck Pool, streamed rapidly northwest to Eastern Fan Senior General in the Supreme Palace Enclosure and vanished, red-yellow with a ground-lighting tail.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，透雲星出壁壘陣南，如太白，東南速行，至羽林軍沒，赤黃，有尾跡。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: a cloud-piercing star emerged south of Wall and Ramparts Formation, like Venus, moved swiftly southeast, vanished at Palace Guard, red-yellow, with a tail trail.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, a star pierced the clouds south of Wall and Ramparts Formation, Venus-bright, sped southeast to Palace Guard and vanished, red-yellow and trailing.

sentences.zh: 八月乙未，透雲星出閣道東，如太白，東北急流，至濁沒，赤黃，有尾跡，明燭地。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yiwei: a cloud-piercing star emerged east of Forbidden Passage, like Venus, flowed rapidly northeast, vanished in the Murky, red-yellow, with a tail trail, its brightness lighting the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yiwei, a star broke through the clouds east of Forbidden Passage, Venus-bright, streamed rapidly northeast into the Murky and vanished, red-yellow with a tail bright enough to light the ground.

sentences.zh: 九月己巳，星出昴東南，如太白，向南慢流，至天苑沒，青白，有尾跡，明燭地。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jisi: a star emerged southeast of Hairy Head, like Venus, flowed slowly southward, vanished at Celestial Meadows, green-white, with a tail trail, its brightness lighting the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jisi, a Venus-bright star appeared southeast of Hairy Head, drifted slowly south to Celestial Meadows and vanished, green-white with a ground-lighting tail.

sentences.zh: 閏九月乙亥，星出河鼓西，如太白，西南急流，入天市垣內沒，青白，有尾跡，明燭地。

translations.literal: Intercalary ninth month, day yihai: a star emerged west of River Drum, like Venus, flowed rapidly southwest, entered within Celestial Market Enclosure and vanished, green-white, with a tail trail, its brightness lighting the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary ninth month, on yihai, a Venus-bright star appeared west of River Drum, streamed rapidly southwest into the Celestial Market Enclosure and vanished, green-white with a tail bright enough to light the ground.

sentences.zh: 又星出天苑東南，如太白，向南急流，至濁沒，青黃，有尾跡，明燭地。

translations.literal: Again, a star emerged southeast of Celestial Meadows, like Venus, flowed rapidly southward, vanished in the Murky, green-yellow, with a tail trail, its brightness lighting the ground.
translations.idiomatic: Again, a Venus-bright star appeared southeast of Celestial Meadows, streamed rapidly south into the Murky and vanished, green-yellow with a ground-lighting tail.

sentences.zh: 十月辛丑，星出女西北，如太白，西南急流，至牛西北沒，青白，有尾跡，明燭地。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day xinchou: a star emerged northwest of Woman, like Venus, flowed rapidly southwest, vanished northwest of Ox, green-white, with a tail trail, its brightness lighting the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on xinchou, a Venus-bright star appeared northwest of Woman, streamed rapidly southwest to northwest of Ox and vanished, green-white with a tail bright enough to light the ground.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，星出上臺東，如太白，西北急流，至文昌沒，青白，有尾跡，明燭地。

translations.literal: Day guimao: a star emerged east of Upper Terrace, like Venus, flowed rapidly northwest, vanished at Literary Glory, green-white, with a tail trail, its brightness lighting the ground.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, a Venus-bright star appeared east of Upper Terrace, streamed rapidly northwest to Literary Glory and vanished, green-white with a ground-lighting tail.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，星出壁南，如太白，向南急流，入羽林軍沒，赤黃，有尾跡，明燭地。

translations.literal: Day renxu: a star emerged south of Wall, like Venus, flowed rapidly southward, entered Palace Guard and vanished, red-yellow, with a tail trail, its brightness lighting the ground.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, a Venus-bright star appeared south of Wall, streamed rapidly south into Palace Guard and vanished, red-yellow with a ground-lighting tail.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，星出陰德東，如太白，東北慢行，至北斗魁內大理西沒，赤白，有尾跡。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingzi: a star emerged east of Hidden Virtue, like Venus, moved slowly northeast, vanished west of Grand Judge within the Dipper Handle of Northern Dipper, red-white, with a tail trail.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingzi, a Venus-bright star appeared east of Hidden Virtue, drifted slowly northeast to west of Grand Judge inside the Dipper Handle of the Northern Dipper and vanished, red-white and trailing.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，星出中台東，如太白，向北急流，至濁沒，赤黃，有尾跡，明燭地。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: a star emerged east of Middle Terrace, like Venus, flowed rapidly northward, vanished in the Murky, red-yellow, with a tail trail, its brightness lighting the ground.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, a Venus-bright star appeared east of Middle Terrace, streamed rapidly north into the Murky and vanished, red-yellow with a tail bright enough to light the ground.

sentences.zh: 三年五月癸巳，星出織女，如杯，西北慢流，至北斗搖光沒，青白，有尾跡，明燭地。

translations.literal: Year 3, fifth month, day guisi: a star emerged from Weaving Maid, the size of a cup, flowed slowly northwest, vanished at Twinkling Indicator of Northern Dipper, green-white, with a tail trail, its brightness lighting the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, fifth month, on guisi, a cup-sized star appeared at Weaving Maid, drifted slowly northwest to Twinkling Indicator of the Northern Dipper and vanished, green-white with a ground-lighting tail.
